arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Verrilli argued the three-year limit starts when the plaintiff first had actual knowledge.
Guarnieri argued the plain language requires actual knowledge to start the clock.
Wessler argued Congress meant actual knowledge to mean real awareness by the plaintiff.
